_readme: Copy to config.json and fill in. The tool is multi-course: list each course under `courses` with an ID (usually the Moodle course ID), the course URL, and optionally a NotebookLM notebook ID to reuse. Pick which one to run with --course <id>, or add a top-level `defaultCourse`. You can also run ad-hoc with --url / --notebook / --title.
_cookies_note: Cookie auth is tried in this order: (1) cookiesFromBrowser (reads your live browser session via yt-dlp), then (2) the manual `cookies` array merged in as a fallback. Either alone works; both together is most robust. For the manual array, export from Chrome with the EditThisCookie extension and paste the JSON. Only MoodleSessionprod is strictly required.
_output_note: Per-course artifacts live at <root>/<courseId>/{downloads,audio,manifests}/. Set an explicit root to keep every course's files isolated.
_notebooklm_note: Enable to auto-upload extracted MP3s to NotebookLM via the `nlm` CLI. Set `notebookId` per course to reuse a specific notebook; leave null and a new one will be created on first run (its ID is persisted to <root>/<courseId>/manifests/uploads.json).
_selectors_note: Selectors are verified against lemida.biu.ac.il — other Moodle instances may need tweaks to run.mjs.
